goal: Test whether pre-draw lottery-number distributions exhibit transport-stable regime structure that improves frozen ranking out of sample, using Wasserstein/Sinkhorn geometry rather than energy-distance or spectral surrogates.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: Energy distance is a kernel/distance discrepancy statistic; v316 uses explicit optimal transport plans and Wasserstein barycentric geometry with frozen transport costs.
Wavelet temporal ranking is unrelated to transport-plan geometry.

design.representation: For each draw, map only prior-draw information into normalized empirical measures over the main-number support using trailing marginal frequency, recency and pairwise co-occurrence summaries; target draw outcomes are excluded.

transportGeometry.groundCost: absolute normalized number-index distance with a second frozen co-occurrence-derived cost variant
transportGeometry.barycenter: trailing-window Wasserstein barycenter computed from prior draws only
transportGeometry.score: rank numbers by frozen contribution to reducing transport distance between current prior-state measure and the historical barycentric reference

matchedCostNulls: uniform random lines at identical line count

inference.primaryMetric: paired mean main-number hits per line versus matched-cost random baseline
inference.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across frozen candidates within each game plus family-level audit for any extreme event
inference.extremeEventAudit: Any 5+, full hit, repeat5+ or corrected statistical anomaly triggers lineage verification, timestamp verification, behavior deduplication, exact matched-cost null replay and independent post-freeze replication before interpretation.
inference.promotionRule: No real-money promotion from v316 alone even if OOS is positive; an untouched prospective replication is mandatory.

failureGate: Persist as negative and do not retune if OOS uplift disappears, fails multiplicity correction, is explained by marginal-frequency/recency baselines, or any extreme event fails audit.
